name: cable overhead curl
description: A curl with the cable set high so the arms are lifted overhead. It trains the biceps through a short range.
instructions: Set both pulleys high with a handle on each and stand in the middle.
Hold a handle in each hand, palms up, with your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Keep your upper arms still and curl the handles toward your head.
Straighten your arms slowly back out to the sides.
